title: QA Engineer
description:
**QA Engineer – 2 to 3 Years**  
**BNBRun Solutions LLP \| Ahmedabad (Work from Office) \| Full\-time**

**About Us**  
BNBRun builds cloud ERP and CRM for regulated manufacturing – pharma, medical devices, chemicals and more – serving customers across 7 countries. Our product is built in\-house, with a strong focus on customization, audit trails and compliance.

**Responsibilities**

* Test ERP/CRM modules – inventory, production, sales, purchase, accounts, QA/QC
* Write and execute test cases, test scenarios and test plans from business requirements
* Perform functional, regression, integration and UAT testing
* Test REST APIs using Postman
* Validate data and reports using SQL queries
* Verify compliance features – audit trails, user roles, approval workflows
* Log, track and retest bugs; coordinate with developers for timely fixes
* Support client implementations and release sign\-offs

**Must\-Have**

* 2–3 years of manual testing experience in web applications
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC and bug life cycle
* Test case design and defect tracking (Jira or similar)
* API testing with Postman
* Basic SQL (MySQL preferred)

**Good to Have**

* Automation testing with Selenium, Playwright or Pytest
* Experience testing ERP, CRM or business applications
* Exposure to pharma/regulated domains (GMP, 21 CFR Part 11\)

Pay: ₹112,000\.00 \- ₹360,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Location:

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380054 (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Job Description
Technource is looking for a **Junior Project Coordinator** who is interested in building a career in **software project coordination and delivery**. The role involves working closely with **Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders** to support smooth project execution, task tracking, requirement coordination, and timely communication. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with good **communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills** who wants to grow into project management within an IT services environment.


Describe Skill and Experience
* Basic understanding of the **software development lifecycle, web/mobile application projects, and Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Assist Project Managers and senior team members with **task tracking, team follow\-ups, requirement coordination, and project updates** to ensure activities move as planned.
* Coordinate with **Developers, QA, Business Analysts, Designers, and other project team members** to track dependencies, pending discussions, and project progress.
* Ability to understand basic client or business requirements and maintain proper **project documentation, task updates, meeting notes, and follow\-up records**.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Jira, Trello, Slack**, or similar project management and communication platforms is an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of technology stacks such as **Laravel, Node.js, React.js, mobile technologies, or other software development technologies** will be preferred.
* Good **English communication and presentation skills**, attention to detail, strong follow\-up ability, and willingness to learn client communication and project management under guidance.

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Exp: \-4 TO 5 Years**

Manual Testing: Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke/Sanity Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, Exploratory Testing.  
Test Documentation: Test Scenario, Test Case, Test Data, RTM, Test Summary Report, Defect Reports.  
Defect Management: Defect identification, logging, severity/priority classification, defect lifecycle, retesting \& closure.  
Automation Testing: Selenium / Playwright / Cypress; automation framework development and maintenance.  
Frameworks: Page Object Model (POM).  
API Testing: Postman, REST API testing.  
Database Testing: SQL queries, CRUD operations.  
Performance Testing Basic/Intermediate knowledge of JMeter, load testing, stress testing, response\-time analysis.  
Version Control: Git, GitLab/GitHub, branching, merge, commit, pull/merge requests.  
Bug Tracking: Jira or similar tools.  
Agile/Scrum : Sprint planning, daily stand\-up, backlog, refinement, review, retrospective.  
Requirement Analysis: Understanding BRD/FRD/URS, identifying testable requirements, clarification of gaps.  
Test Strategy: Test planning, estimation, test approach, risk\-based testing.

Release Testing: Build verification, release validation, regression testing, production verification.  
Mobile Testing: Basic Android/iOS testing and responsive testing.  
Communication: Client communication, requirement clarification, defect discussion and status reporting.  
Provide regular status updates to stakeholders.  
Take ownership of QA deliverables, timelines, and project quality without continuous supervision.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Exp. CTC

Experience:

* Software testing: 2 years (Preferred)

Location:

* Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
